jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading. Everything is white line art except the colours described. No text, letters or captions. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: a huge banquet hall in thin white line art, one very long table covered with bowls of food. Scene: close-up across the table: two smiling men drawn all in WHITE (white clothes, white skin, white hair), NOT coloured, NOT black-filled sit facing each other; each one holds ONE very long spoon (as long as a broom) in both hands and puts the food at its end into the OTHER man's open mouth across the table; the two long spoons cross in the middle above the bowls. Warm golden light. Only the warm light has colour. ONLY these two people. Normal human anatomy: each person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Each leg runs from the hip to ONE foot, the feet point the same way as the knees, no third foot or extra leg, and the legs of different people never merge or overlap; people in the background stand clearly apart from each other.  Every object (boats, bowls, buckets, walls, furniture) is drawn WHITE-filled with thin dark outlines, never black-filled; the ground and sky are pure black with thin white lines, no brown, no green, no grey fills.
